summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of an Advance Notice Policy for director nominations. The policy establishes deadlines for shareholder nominations ahead of meetings (30 days before AGM, 15 days after special meeting announcement) and is subject to shareholder ratification at the next annual general meeting. No transaction, price, or financial terms are involved. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation.
